tools.title: hook-edit

tools.description: For a session (default: the newest) and an event (record.before_start, record.start, record.pause, calendar.ending, calendar.ended, record.before_stop, record.stop, record.auto_start, record.auto_stop, transcript.phrase, transcript.final, calendar.matched, session.saved, notes.generated), every hook and whether it would fire, with the reason either way (its event, enabled, each [hooks.match] field). For transcript.phrase, utterance is the one to judge ({text, speaker?, start_ms?, end_ms?}; speaker default remote_1). Nothing runs; no dedup or cooldown is consumed.
tools.name: hook_explain
tools.title: hook-explain

tools.description: Replay a session's raw event log (its events.jsonl; session default: the newest) or a given events.jsonl file through the hook triggers, as the engine judged it live: every [[hooks]] entry on each event (disabled ones too: hook names just one; enable=true judges every one as if it were on), with transcript.phrase cooldowns and calendar.ending leads, then dedup (the replay's own, starting empty). Returns decisions (every verdict in order: seq, topic, event, hook, fire, reason, dedup) and fires (the ones that fire, each with the oats.hook-event/1 envelope it gets). run=false (default) runs nothing and writes nothing; run=true runs each fire's command in order and waits for it, as hook-test does, and writes the verdicts and runs to the session's hook-runs.jsonl tagged simulated.
tools.name: hook_simulate
tools.title: hook-simulate

tools.description: The hook ledger: each session's hook-runs.jsonl, one row per decision (kind verdict: fire or skip, with the reason) and per run (kind run: run_id, exit, timed_out, error, started, ms, stdout_tail, stderr_tail; test for hook-test, simulated for hook-simulate run=true), {kind, at, session, run_id, hook, event, seq, dedup, verdict, reason, outcome, ...}, oldest first. session: just that one (default: every session); hook, event: just those; outcome: fire, skip, ok, failed or timed_out; limit: only the newest that many rows. skipped counts lines that are not whole JSON.
tools.name: hook_runs
tools.title: hook-runs

tools.description: The hook event contract (oats.hook-event/1): every event a hook can name with its description, the bus topics that produce it, how its dedup key is formed, the JSON Schema of its data and an example envelope; the envelope schema; the OATS_* environment a run gets. event: just that one.
